content:
Noah (PM): Quick preflight: I'm assembling a short operability + pricing floor checklist for launch. Want owners and any "must-not-ship" items before I finalize the shiproom slate.

Zara (Eng): I can take perf targets & autoscale harness. Two engineering caveats: (1) p95 target of 200ms should be scoped to 'short chat' requests (<=32 tokens) and baseline model families; (2) NVLink mem-frag for long sequences still open  we can ship with a sequence-length warning documented.

Keiko (SRE): I'll own monitoring, canaries, and runbooks. Must-haves: synthetic correctness canary (area under curve check for logits), p99 tail latency alerts, and an exercised model-fallback path that reroutes to quantized variant under memory pressure. Also require a scripted region failover drill in CI.

Omar (FinOps): I'll produce a GA price floor (hosted per-token, embeddings, and reserved commit tiers) with two example commit scenarios for sales. Need five business days to finalize enterprise tier discounts; GA can publish floor + "enterprise tiers pending" note.

deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-7712 (autoscale-smoke) assigned: Zara; PROD-7713 (regional-failover-drill) assigned: Keiko. :white_check_mark:

Noah (PM): Proposed compact acceptance checklist. React with :thumbsup: to approve or call out absolute blockers.

```
LAUNCH PREFLIGHT CHECK (owners)
- Uptime SLA: Dedicated 99.9% monthly, Hosted 99.5% initial (owner: Noah)
- Latency guidance: publish p50/p95 by model family; infra target p95 <= 200ms for <=32-token requests (owner: Zara)
- Monitoring: synthetic canaries for latency + correctness; p99 tail/queue-depth alerts (owner: Keiko)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 playbooks, throttling and model-fallback procedures (owner: Keiko)
- Autoscale & Failover: autoscale smoke harness + scripted regional failover CI job (owners: Zara/Keiko)
- Docs: GA quickstart, migration notes for pilots, operational expectations + sequence length guidance (owner: Noah)
- Support: business-hours triage; SEV1 on-call escalation path documented (owner: Noah)
- Pricing: published GA floor + example commit scenarios; enterprise tiers follow-up (owner: Omar)
```

Zara (Eng): Blocking items: autoscale burst validation (1k+ rps synthetic bursts) and a KV-cache cold-start regression test. I'll open the autoscale smoke PR by Tues.

Keiko (SRE): Blocking: regional failover automation needs to be runnable in CI and we must demonstrate fallback under load. Otherwise OK.

Omar (FinOps): I'll share draft numbers by Fri EOD.

Noah (PM): I'll lock this as the preflight floor for shiproom unless someone flags a hard blocker by EOD. Thanks all.

Zara (Eng): :thumbsup: pending smoke PR.

Keiko (SRE): :thumbsup: pending failover validation.

Omar (FinOps): :thumbsup: (draft incoming).
